snippet.title: Jan-Ken-PRO! - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Get it on itch.io:
https://minichimera.itch.io/jan-ken-pro

Or Gamejolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/jankenpro/286240

Jan Ken Pro! is an Arcade local multiplayer game where you have to beat your opponent by using huge stones in the shape of Rock, Paper or Scissors.

More info: https://minichimera.wordpress.com/
https://twitter.com/robsonsiebel
